==Usage==
To use this template, paste the following code into the top of the article, filling all relevant fields:
<pre><nowiki>{{Competition
|prev=
|conc=
|next=
|image=
|name=
|type=
|date=
|place=
|outcome=
|competitors=
|organizers=
|hosts=
|league=
}}
</nowiki></pre>

==Data fields==
*{{Para|prev}} Any relevant competitions that occurred previously
*{{Para|conc}}  Any relevant competitions that occurred concurrently 
*{{Para|next}}  Any relevant competitions that occurred next
*{{Para|image}} logo of competition or picture of the competition taking place 
*{{Para|name}} name
*{{Para|type}} type of competition (e.g. beauty pageant, race, [[Limmie]] game, etc) 
*{{Para|date}} date
*{{Para|place}} location 
*{{Para|outcome}} outcome
*{{Para|competitors}} competitors; if there are teams, list only teams, not participants in each team 
*{{Para|organizers}}  organizers (e.g. [[Vranki]] organized the [[Voxx Vortex 5000]])
*{{Para|hosts}}  hosts (e.g. [[Fodesinbeed Annodue]] hosted the [[Boonta Eve Classic]])
*{{Para|league}} league (e.g. the [[Galactic Cup of Limmie]])
